summary: Tested HRlytic organizational planning features (Headcount Planning, Workforce Alignment, Org Health) plus seed-data realism. All 3 new backend endpoints return valid JSON with expected KPIs, all 3 new frontend pages render correctly with charts/cards, sidebar Planning section has all 5 nav links, existing dashboards unaffected. Backend pytest: 19/19 passed. Frontend Playwright smoke: all checks passed.
passed_tests: GET /api/dashboard/headcount-plan returns 200 with kpis (total_headcount=386, target_headcount=600, total_gap=214, fill_rate=64.3%), department_plan (10 depts), critical_gaps, monthly_hiring_plan (12 months)

GET /api/dashboard/workforce-alignment returns 200 with 5 strategic objectives, kpis (overall_readiness, critical_count, on_track, total_skill_gaps), each objective has skill_coverage with Strong/Adequate/Gap status

GET /api/dashboard/org-health returns 200 with kpis (overall_span, manager_ratio, hierarchy_depth, healthy_depts, attention_depts, restructure_depts), department_health (10 depts), band_pyramid with ideal_pct + deviation
Seed data realism: turnover_rate is realistic (not 0% or 100%); leaving reasons have varied distribution (>= 3 non-zero reasons)

Frontend /headcount-plan page renders all 6 KPI cards (Current HC, Target HC, Total Gap, Fill Rate, Critical Gaps, Depts Under), Target vs Current chart, Gap Analysis bar chart, Hiring Plan Timeline (12 months), Dept Fill Rate list, Critical Role Gaps
Frontend /workforce-alignment page renders 5 KPI cards, radar chart, readiness bar chart, 5 expandable objective cards; clicking an objective reveals skill coverage with Strong/Adequate/Gap dots

Frontend /org-health page renders 7 KPI cards (Headcount, Span of Control, Manager Ratio, Hierarchy Depth, Healthy, Attention, Restructure), Span of Control chart with ideal range reference lines (5-10), Band Pyramid (Actual vs Ideal), 10 Department Structure Health cards
Sidebar Planning section contains all 5 expected links (HC Planning, WF Alignment, Org Health, Scenario Sim, Succession) with correct data-testid attributes
No console errors on any of the 3 new pages
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1485 lines - getting large. Consider splitting endpoint groups (planning, insights, people) into separate routers/modules for maintainability.

Org Health endpoint: the loop 'for d in dept_health: d["issues"] = [i for i in d["issues"] if i]' is inside the outer dept loop, so it re-filters earlier depts each iteration. Functionally OK but O(n^2). Move outside the outer for-loop.
Static dicts TARGET_HEADCOUNT and STRATEGIC_OBJECTIVES are hardcoded in server.py — fine for MVP, but should be configurable (env/db) before production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (HC Plan, WF Alignment, Org Health all render, charts visible, no errors)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data (already reset via DELETE /api/data/reset before this iteration). Verified turnover rate and leaving reasons are now varied/realistic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 22 dashboard endpoints, all working. Planning pages have data-testids: headcount-plan-page, workforce-alignment-page, org-health-page; sidebar planning nav testids: sidebar-nav-hc-planning, sidebar-nav-wf-alignment, sidebar-nav-org-health, sidebar-nav-scenario-sim, sidebar-nav-succession. WF Alignment objectives are expandable via click on [data-testid^=objective-]. Note: the strict-case label matching in tests can give false negatives — KPI labels are rendered uppercase via CSS.
